about: The watcher loop's cheap gates, each run as the loop runs it against a data/ of its own. replyOpen: Test-ChatqReplyOpen (src/phone.ps1). held: Test-ChatqHeldWaiting (src/phone-extras.ps1), files aged against the clock. heldSummary: Send-ChatqHeldSummary (src/phone-extras.ps1) with its claim stubbed, due when it gets that far: something held, the last failed push (triedSecondsAgo) 5 minutes old or more, now outside quiet hours on the local clock. auto: Test-ChatqAutoWanted (src/auto-continue.ps1). soon: Send-ChatqUsageSoon (src/phone-extras.ps1) with the alert stubbed: next is the time the loop wakes for a soon alert, due the lanes whose key the process records now (sentBefore: already recorded), send those that then go (fileHas: already in data/usage-alerts.json, sent at 08:00 or at its value; fileText: the file as it is), alerts how many were sent. route: SPEC 1.4, whether Send-ChatqAlert registers the alert as answerable (New-ChatqReplyAlert called), every gate before it held open; links is Get-ChatqReplyConfig's Links, secrets opened with protected ones all failing. pollSeconds: Get-ChatqReplyPollSeconds (src/phone-down.ps1). listenText: Get-ChatqReplyListenText (src/phone-down.ps1) under a culture, with its time separator. A file is read as the tool reads it, so a zoneless stamp is UTC to 5.1 and the zone's wall clock to pwsh 7.
